raw_segments.text: I stood with my lamp held out over the stair rail, and he came slowly within its light.
It was a shaded lamp, to shine upon a book, and its circle of light was very contracted,
so that he was in it for a mere instant, and then out of it.
In the instant, I had seen a face that was strange to me, looking up with an incomprehensible
air of being touched and pleased by the sight of me.
